notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Zacama's first ability by paying {2}{R}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Zacama.
Zacama's ability from step 2 fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Zacama from exile by paying {2}.
When Zacama enters, it triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Repeat.
